title: CAP-IQA: Context-Aware Prompt-Guided CT Image Quality Assessment

bias_targets.methodology: Integrating image-specific context prompts with global medical text priors via dynamic cross-prompt attention to mitigate the model's over-reliance on idealized definitions, evaluated by measuring performance correlation (PLCC, SROCC, KROCC) against expert radiologist assessments.

Analyzing the distribution of prediction residuals and absolute errors across different image quality score groups using kernel density plots, box plots, and the Kruskal-Wallis H-test to verify the absence of systematic scoring bias toward specific quality levels.
